opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Vacation Scholarships
opportunities.summary: Support undergraduate students from low-income Scottish households to develop their research skills by undertaking a short research project in the summer vacation, under the supervision of an established academic.
